theorems.name_zh: 细化作用类质量的完整一位匹配
theorems.statement: Full kernel preservation is equivalent to a mass-profile-preserving permutation of action germs. Refine before matching; the union of all compatible shared-frame one-digit lift components is complete and disjoint for the fixed seed.
assumptions: fixed prime and native X6 or explicitly repeated-block diagnostic
fixed control ports, finite nonsingular integer actions, positive exact row law
fixed supplied seed at precision m+C; arrow-boundary linear carry observer

theorems.name_zh: 全匹配的一位修复纤维为仿射空间
theorems.statement: A nonempty complete one-digit fiber of the weighted-germ stabilizer is an affine F_p frame space, including permutations of new germ classes; its cardinality is p^d. Equal hull/component cardinalities give a finite coverage certificate.
assumptions: fixed prime and native X6 or explicitly repeated-block diagnostic
fixed control ports, finite nonsingular integer actions, positive exact row law
fixed supplied seed at precision m+C; arrow-boundary linear carry observer

theorems.name_zh: 质量分裂与共同几何两类障碍
theorems.statement: Mismatching child mass-profile multisets prohibit every lift above that seed before geometric solving. Matching profiles can still fail all joint finite-field systems; yD=0,yr!=0 is a separate geometric witness.
assumptions: fixed prime and native X6 or explicitly repeated-block diagnostic
fixed control ports, finite nonsingular integer actions, positive exact row law
fixed supplied seed at precision m+C; arrow-boundary linear carry observer

theorems.name_zh: 固定动作表的有限碰撞截止层
theorems.statement: For a finite fixed action table, all non-scalar germ collisions end at finite depth computed from the relative normalized matrix minus I. This does not bound symmetry-lift lifetime.
assumptions: fixed prime and native X6 or explicitly repeated-block diagnostic
fixed control ports, finite nonsingular integer actions, positive exact row law
fixed supplied seed at precision m+C; arrow-boundary linear carry observer

theorems.name_zh: 精度细化下概率核残差的单调性
theorems.statement: For a fixed actual frame and probability law, each source-row total variation of action-germ mass is nondecreasing under precision refinement; it is not the first-hit probability defect.
assumptions: fixed prime and native X6 or explicitly repeated-block diagnostic
fixed control ports, finite nonsingular integer actions, positive exact row law
fixed supplied seed at precision m+C; arrow-boundary linear carry observer

theorems.name_zh: 概率分裂风险见证与BRC保持
theorems.statement: In the stopped repeated-block X6 witness, risk agrees at R=2 (1/7) but becomes457/11702 versus1/26 atR=3; first-time mass differs at tick5. Exact scalar copies preserve aggregate mass symmetry without an atomwise weight bijection; inherited weighted-row certification gives all-time BRC first-hit preservation.
assumptions: fixed prime and native X6 or explicitly repeated-block diagnostic
fixed control ports, finite nonsingular integer actions, positive exact row law
fixed supplied seed at precision m+C; arrow-boundary linear carry observer
